long_biography.plain_text:
Formula Ford of Rutland was Mark Saba's extension of an earlier Vermont car-dealership operation. He established the Rutland outlet in 2003 after building the Formula Ford name in Barre, and came to hold controlling interests in Ford and Nissan businesses. The dealership remains active, while his wider portfolio includes property used by automotive operations.

On Lake Champlain, Saba founded a powerboat dealership and developed Bay Harbor Marina at Colchester. He also joined partners in the acquisition of Gaines Marina across the state line in New York, expanding the group's service and berthing activities. A Burlington-based businessman, he has served as a Northfield Savings Bank trustee and held leadership positions in Vermont's automobile-dealer and chamber organisations.
